Keywords: tw useCssElement className View Text Pressable Kaplun
Description: Kaplun maps className via react-native-css useCssElement on @/tw wrappers — not raw RN or styled().
Do: Import View Text Pressable TextInput ScrollView Image from @/tw in screens.
Don't: Import react-native View/Text for className styling in screens.
Code Example:
import { View, Text, Pressable } from '@/tw';
<View className='flex-1 bg-canvas px-md'>
  <Text className='text-body-md text-ink'>Hello</Text>
</View>
Notes: Exceptions: Platform Dimensions FlatList KeyboardAvoidingView and documented raw-RN Clay components.

Keywords: useCssElement react-native-css className style map bridge
Description: Bridge className to style with useCssElement from react-native-css (Kaplun NativeWind v5 pattern).
Do: Wrap new primitives with useCssElement(Comp props { className: 'style' }) in src/tw.
Don't: Use NativeWind styled() or expect raw RN to accept className.
Notes: This is NOT cssInterop — Kaplun uses the react-native-css hook API.

Keywords: @theme global.css clay tokens color spacing radius
Description: All Clay design tokens live in src/global.css @theme — Tailwind v4 CSS config.
Do: Add missing colors/spacing/radii to @theme then use semantic className.
Don't: Hardcode hex in components or invent ad-hoc arbitrary colors.
Notes: Imported once from src/app/_layout.tsx via import '@/global.css'.

Keywords: cn twMerge clsx conditional className variants
Description: Merge conditional Tailwind classes with cn from @/tw/cn.
Do: Use cn('base' condition && 'extra') or compound clay* utilities.
Don't: String-concatenate classNames without twMerge (conflicts break).
Code Example: import { cn } from '@/tw/cn';\n<View className={cn('rounded-lg bg-surface-card', selected && 'border-border-strong')} />
Notes: Also exposes clayInput clayCard clayFeatureCardBase clayButtonBase.

Keywords: android layout balloon useCssElement StyleSheet ClayAnimatedButton
Description: useCssElement can drop layout classes on Android (ballooned cards floating text).
Do: If Android layout breaks switch that component to raw RN + StyleSheet.create like ClayAnimatedButton.
Don't: Force more NativeWind wrappers when Android layout already failed.
Code Example: // Prefer StyleSheet for fragile animated Clay controls\nconst styles = StyleSheet.create({ root: { backgroundColor: '#0a0a0a' } });
Notes: Documented on automate/profile screens and ClayAnimatedButton/ClaySpinner/AuthScreen.

Keywords: StyleSheet.create screen className tailwind convention
Description: Screens must style with className on @/tw — StyleSheet reserved for known Android-safe exceptions.
Do: Write className strings for screen/layout UI.
Don't: Use StyleSheet.create inside screen files.

Keywords: reanimated-platform animated web stub className

Keywords: metro withNativewind nativewind/metro typescriptEnvPath

Do: Use require('nativewind/metro') and keep inlineRequires after wrap.
Don't: Use typo package native-wind/metro or forget typescriptEnvPath.
Notes: Kaplun CSS entry is imported in _layout — not via metro input option.

Keywords: global.css tailwindcss theme preflight utilities nativewind/theme
Description: Single CSS entry imports Tailwind layers + nativewind/theme.
Do: Keep @import order: theme.css preflight utilities then nativewind/theme.
Don't: Split multiple CSS entries or omit nativewind/theme.

Keywords: postcss @tailwindcss/postcss lightningcss
Description: Kaplun uses Tailwind v4 via PostCSS plugin — no classic tailwind.config theme for tokens.
Do: Keep postcss.config.mjs with @tailwindcss/postcss; tokens in @theme.
Don't: Reintroduce JS theme colors that duplicate global.css.
Notes: lightningcss pinned in package.json resolutions.

Keywords: nativewind-env.d.ts reference types triple slash
Description: NativeWind augments RN types via declaration merging.
Do: Create nativewind-env.d.ts with triple-slash reference to nativewind/types and include it in tsconfig.
Don't: Name the file nativewind.d.ts or clash with a folder name
Notes: Kaplun already has nativewind-env.d.ts at repo root.

Keywords: import global.css _layout root entry
Description: Import the CSS entry once at the app root so Metro/NativeWind compile styles.
Do: Import '@/global.css' in src/app/_layout.tsx only.
Don't: Import global.css in every screen or forget the root import.
Notes: Without this import className utilities will not resolve at runtime.

Keywords: cssInterop className target nativeStyleToProp third party
Description: Tag components so runtime resolves className into styles — for custom native or third-party only.
Do: Use cssInterop when a component does not forward className or needs style attrs as props.
Don't: Use cssInterop on every Kaplun component; prefer @/tw useCssElement for first-party.
Notes: cssInterop has a runtime cost — resolve styles inject handlers etc.

Keywords: remapProps multiple style props FlatList contentContainerClassName
Description: Create className aliases for third-party components with several *Style props.
Do: Use remapProps for FlatList-like APIs with contentContainerStyle etc.
Don't: Manually wrap every style prop with cssInterop when remapProps suffices.
Notes: remapProps passes a special empty-looking object so third-party code is not broken.

Keywords: useColorScheme colorScheme setColorScheme toggleColorScheme darkMode
Description: Read and override device color scheme via NativeWind hook.
Do: Use useColorScheme to read; require darkMode class strategy before set/toggle.
Don't: Call setColorScheme while darkMode is media (throws).
Code Example: import { useColorScheme } from 'nativewind';\nconst { colorScheme, setColorScheme, toggleColorScheme } = useColorScheme();
Notes: Under the hood: Appearance on native prefers-color-scheme on web.

Keywords: vars custom properties runtime cascade theme dynamic
Description: Set CSS variables from JS so values cascade to descendants.
Do: Use style={vars({ '--brand': color })} for dynamic theming islands.
Don't: Scatter text-[#hex] arbitrary colors when a token or var would cascade.
Notes: Reactive — children update when vars change.

Keywords: useUnstableNativeVariable CSS variable read javascript prop
Description: Read a resolved CSS variable value in JavaScript.
Do: Use to pass theme colors into third-party props that need a color string.
Don't: Use for styling when className or @/tw useCSSVariable would suffice.
Notes: API may change (unstable). Kaplun also exports useCSSVariable from @/tw.

Keywords: NativeWindStyleSheet registerCompiled getFlag deprecated v2
Description: v4/v5 StyleSheet helpers are build/runtime internals — not app API.
Do: Use useColorScheme for appearance; leave StyleSheet internals alone.
Don't: Call NativeWindStyleSheet.setOutput/setAppearance from v2/v3.
Notes: NativeWindStyleSheet API from v2/v3 no longer exists.

Keywords: withNativeWind input output inlineRem experiments inlineAnimations
Description: Metro HOC options: input/output/inlineRem/configPath/hotServerOptions + experiments.
Do: Only set options you need; Kaplun currently uses typescriptEnvPath + globalClassNamePolyfill.
Don't: Enable experiments.inlineAnimations casually during active UI fast-refresh work.
Notes: inlineRem defaults to 14 on native; false disables rem inlining.

Keywords: ios android web native windows osx platform modifiers
Description: Apply styles per platform with Tailwind platform variants.
Do: Use ios: android: web: native: for real platform differences.
Don't: Create duplicate component files when a prefix would suffice.
Notes: native: = all platforms except web.

Keywords: explicit styles light dark conditional transitions quirks
Description: RN has bugs with conditionally-only styles — always declare both sides.
Do: Provide default + dark: (or both states) together especially for transitions.
Don't: Apply only dark:text-white with no light default.
Notes: Critical for animations/transitions on native.

Keywords: dp px density independent rem fontSize units
Description: NativeWind treats dp and px as equivalent; prefer px in theme values.
Do: Use 10px-style values in @theme/arbitrary classes and let NativeWind normalize.
Don't: Assume web px and RN dp will match without checking.
Notes: Text rem: 14 on native 16 on web by default.

Keywords: flex-1 flex-col flexDirection alignContent flexShrink Yoga
Description: RN flex defaults differ from web (column flexShrink 0 alignContent flex-start).
Do: Explicitly set flex-col/flex-row and use flex-1 for fill layouts.
Don't: Assume web flex defaults (row shrink 1).
Notes: Yoga 3 (RN 0.74+) fixed row-reverse margin/padding edge flip.

Keywords: grid unsupported class native web-only compatibility
Description: NativeWind accepts all classes but only applies supported styles on native.
Do: Prefer flex layouts on native; gate web-only utilities with web:.
Don't: Expect grid or other web-only utilities to work on iOS/Android.
Notes: Check utility docs compatibility tables when unsure.

Keywords: hover focus active Pressable TextInput onPressIn onHoverIn
Description: Pseudo-classes map to RN event props on compatible components.
Do: Use active: on Pressable; hover:/focus: only where events exist.
Don't: Use hover: on View/Text which lack onHoverIn/Out.
Notes: Combine with hover:active:focus: — all must match.

Don't: Expect disabled: on wrappers that swallow the disabled prop.
Notes: empty: = component has no children.

Keywords: group group-active group-hover group-focus named group children
Description: Style children from parent Pressable/group state.
Do: Add group/{name} on parent and group-active/{name}: on children.
Don't: Omit /name when nesting multiple groups (collisions).
Notes: Works with transitions on group state changes.

Keywords: dataSet data-active attribute selector react-native-web

Do: Use [&[data-active]]: utilities with dataSet={{ active }} when needed.
Don't: Rely on data attributes for core Kaplun native UX (prefer props/state).
Notes: Presence and equality selectors supported.

Keywords: darkMode media system Appearance userInterfaceStyle Expo

Don't: Expect system dark mode without automatic in app.json.

Keywords: colorScheme.set light dark system AsyncStorage persist
Description: Allow user override of light/dark/system.

Keywords: vars themes brand christmas useColorScheme cascade
Description: Build multi-theme trees with vars() islands + useColorScheme.
Do: Scope theme vars on a parent View; nest for sub-themes.
Don't: Mutate global CSS for per-user theme switches at runtime.
Notes: Kaplun primary tokens stay in global.css @theme; vars for runtime overrides only.

Keywords: vw vh w-screen h-screen Dimensions polyfill
Description: vw/vh polyfilled via Dimensions.get('window').
Do: Use for full-bleed relative to window when flex is insufficient.
Don't: Prefer flex-1 over vh for ordinary screen fill.
Notes: Recomputes with window size changes.

Keywords: p-safe m-safe env safe-area-inset SafeAreaProvider
Description: NativeWind safe utilities use env(safe-area-inset-*) / safe-area-context on native.
Do: Use p-safe px-safe pt-safe pb-safe or Kaplun screen-shell helpers.
Don't: Ignore insets and put CTAs under home indicator.
Code Example: <View className='flex-1 bg-canvas p-safe' />\n// or Kaplun: className='pt-safe pb-safe px-md'
Notes: Expo Router already wraps SafeAreaProvider. Kaplun also has screen-shell clearance.

Keywords: m-safe p-safe mx-safe px-safe my-safe py-safe mt-safe pt-safe
Description: Full safe-area utility set for each edge and axis.
Do: Pick the edge/axis utility that matches the fixed chrome.
Don't: Pad every screen with p-safe when only the tab bar needs clearance.
Notes: Web uses CSS env(); Chrome may need -webkit-fill-available on ancestors for h-screen-safe.

Keywords: calc same unit percentage px rem em var limitations
Description: calc() works when operands share a unit family; no mixed % + px.
Do: Use calc with all px or all % (or rem/em consistently).
Don't: Write calc(100% - 20px) or put operators inside custom properties.
Code Example: width: calc(var(--w) - 20px); /* --w must be px */\nwidth: calc(var(--w) - 20%); /* --w must be % */
Notes: Operators cannot live inside the custom property value itself.

Keywords: var CSS variable theme arbitrary className
Description: Use var() in theme values arbitrary classes and custom CSS.
Do: Reference --tokens from @theme or vars() ancestors.
Don't: Expect operators inside var definitions to evaluate.
Notes: Works with calc(var(--x) + 20px) when units match.

Keywords: responsive breakpoints sm md lg native devices web theme
Description: Default Tailwind breakpoints are web-oriented — not tuned for phones.
Do: Prefer flex and platform variants for mobile layouts; use breakpoints sparingly.
Don't: Design phone UI primarily around sm:/md: web breakpoints.
Notes: Nativewind docs warn default theme is not yet designed for native devices.

Keywords: text color cascade View Text restrict RN
Description: RN does not cascade color from View to Text.
Do: Put text-* color classes on Text (or TextInput) themselves.
Don't: Set text-red-500 on a parent View expecting children to inherit.
Notes: Common troubleshooting footgun — works on web fails on native.

Keywords: textOpacity borderOpacity backgroundOpacity divideOpacity disabled
Description: Dynamic opacity corePlugins disabled for performance; opacity baked into color.
Do: Use text-ink/50 style slash opacity or tokenized translucent colors.
Don't: Expect text-opacity-* utilities without enabling plugins.
Notes: Re-enable plugins in Tailwind config only if you truly need dynamic opacity vars.

Keywords: platformColor platformSelect systemRed android colorError
Description: Reference OS system colors via nativewind/theme helpers in theme config.
Do: Use platformSelect + platformColor for system semantic colors.
Don't: Pass PlatformColor objects directly in className strings.
Code Example: const { platformSelect, platformColor } = require('nativewind/theme');\n// theme color: platformSelect({ ios: platformColor('systemRed'), android: platformColor('?android:colorError'), default: 'red' })
Notes: Useful for system alerts/dialogs — Kaplun prefers Clay tokens for app UI.

Keywords: specificity important inline remapped className order
Description: Specificity: !important > inline/remapped (RTL) > className (CSS order).
Do: Use ! only to fix cross-platform remapped conflicts; prefer clean className.
Don't: Fight inline styles with more classNames without understanding order.
Code Example: <Text className='text-error' style={{ color: 'green' }} /> // green wins\n<Text className='!text-error' style={{ color: 'green' }} /> // error wins
Notes: Remapped styles act like inline — order preserved for RN ecosystem.

Keywords: inline style merge className black white
Description: NativeWind merges className with inline style using specificity rules.
Do: Prefer className; use inline for animated/dynamic one-offs only.
Don't: Assume className always beats style without !.
Notes: Documented in custom components guide.

Keywords: custom component defaultStyles variant className props
Description: First-party components should accept className and merge defaults — no cssInterop needed.
Do: Merge default + variant + className via cn; forward ...props.
Don't: Call cssInterop when writing your own View/Text wrappers (Kaplun uses useCssElement once in @/tw).
Code Example: function Card({ className, ...props }) {\n  return <View className={cn('rounded-lg bg-surface-card p-md', className)} {...props} />;\n}
Notes: cssInterop/remapProps are for third-party or custom native modules only.

Keywords: outerClassName innerClassName textClassName multi style
Description: Components with multiple style targets expose multiple *ClassName props.
Do: Pass className to container and textClassName to label Text.
Don't: Collapse all styling into one className when children need separate styles.
Notes: Mirror FlatList contentContainerClassName pattern.

Keywords: third party pick props className style spread
Description: Third-party components that pick only style break NativeWind.
Do: Prefer libs that spread ...props; remapProps/cssInterop when stuck; PR upstream.
Don't: Assume every UI kit accepts className.
Code Example: // Bad: function Lib({ style }) { return <View style={style} /> }\n// Good: function Lib({ style, ...props }) { return <View style={style} {...props} /> }
Notes: Picking props also blocks new RN a11y APIs.

Keywords: FlatList contentContainerClassName columnWrapperClassName indicatorClassName
Description: Style FlatList regions via remapped className props.
Do: remapProps once at entry; use contentContainerClassName for padding.
Don't: Nest Views inside list that break virtualization just to pad.
Notes: Kaplun imports FlatList from react-native when needed (no @/tw wrapper yet).

Keywords: react-native-svg Svg Circle fill stroke strokeWidth nativeStyleToProp
Description: Style SVG via cssInterop mapping fill/stroke to props.
Do: Map className→style and nativeStyleToProp for fill stroke strokeWidth height width.
Don't: Apply className to Svg/Circle without interop.
Notes: Kaplun icons use SymbolIcon — SVG interop only for custom vectors.

Keywords: expo-font Inter OTF PostScript fontFamily useClayFonts
Description: RN fonts are static files — no @font-face no variable fonts no fallback stacks.
Do: Load Inter via Kaplun useClayFonts()/expo-font; map families in @theme.
Don't: Use variable Inter file or font-bold alone expecting Inter Bold.
Code Example: // Kaplun: useClayFonts() gates AuthGate\n// className uses existing type tokens: text-body-md font-display
Notes: File name must match PostScript name or iOS silently fails.

Keywords: font-bold fontWeight fontFamily inter-semibold
Description: font-bold sets fontWeight — it does not switch to Inter-Bold file.
Do: Use the explicit font-family utility for each weight when using custom fonts.
Don't: Expect font-bold to load Inter-Bold automatically.
Notes: RN does not support fallback font arrays — first entry only.

Keywords: expo start clear reset-cache troubleshooting cache
Description: Stale Metro cache is the #1 NativeWind false bug.
Do: Always bun start / npx expo start --clear before deep debugging.
Don't: Debug className bugs against a warm cache with old CSS.
Notes: Also reset-cache for bare RN.

Keywords: tailwindcss CLI input output.css missing utility
Description: Confirm the utility exists in compiled CSS before blaming NativeWind runtime.
Do: Run Tailwind CLI on global.css and grep the utility in output.css.
Don't: Assume every className string is valid without checking compile output.
Notes: If rule missing — Tailwind content paths / @theme issue. If present — runtime/interop issue.

Keywords: verifyInstallation nativewind diagnose component scope
Description: Runtime helper confirms NativeWind install inside a React component.
Do: Call verifyInstallation() inside a component body once while diagnosing.
Don't: Call it at module top-level / global scope.
Code Example: import { verifyInstallation } from 'nativewind';\nfunction Debug() { verifyInstallation(); return null; }
Notes: Do not ship in production screens.

Keywords: DEBUG nativewind logs Windows PowerShell GitHub issue
Description: Enable NativeWind debug logs when filing issues or tracing transforms.
Do: Set DEBUG=nativewind for the start command; capture logs to a file.
Don't: Debug without clearing cache or without DEBUG on all CLI sessions.
Code Example: $env:DEBUG='nativewind'; bun start -- --clear\n# or: $env:DEBUG='nativewind'; bun start *> output.log
Notes: Community CLI may spawn multiple terminals — set DEBUG on each.

Keywords: modifier hover active focus unsupported prop style
Description: Modifiers need both the style capability and the event prop on the host.
Do: Check the component supports the style key and the activating event.
Don't: Put hover: on components without hover handlers.
Notes: See states table for event mapping.

Keywords: tailwindCSS.classAttributes VS Code remapProps IntelliSense
Description: Teach Tailwind IntelliSense about custom *ClassName props.
Do: Add custom props to tailwindCSS.classAttributes in VS Code settings.
Don't: Expect autocomplete on contentContainerClassName without config.
Notes: \"className\"
column11: Only needed when using remapProps/cssInterop custom prop names.

Keywords: cssInterop performance cost resolve styles event handlers
Description: cssInterop terminates className and runs style resolution — not free.
Do: Limit cssInterop to true third-party/native boundaries; reuse @/tw primitives.
Don't: Wrap every leaf in cssInterop.
Notes: remapProps is lighter when you only need prop renaming.

Keywords: inlineAnimations reanimated shared values fast refresh
Description: Optional Metro experiment uses Reanimated inline shared values for animation perf.
Do: Enable only after measuring; accept fast-refresh tradeoffs.
Don't: Enable during heavy UI iteration that relies on fast refresh.
Notes: Known fast-refresh issues with Reanimated inline shared values.

Keywords: StyleSheet.create compile runtime className universal CSS
Description: Compiles Tailwind to StyleSheet.create on native; className polyfill on web.
Do: Write utility className; share components across platforms.
Don't: Rebuild a custom style system with media/hover/container queries by hand.
Code Example: import { Text } from '@/tw';\n<Text className='text-body-md text-ink font-display'>Kaplun</Text>
Notes: Goals: consistent DX performance maintainability across RN platforms.

Keywords: JSX transform third party className no boilerplate
Description: NativeWind works via JSX transform — third-party modules can receive className without custom wrappers when they forward props.
Do: Pass className through; interop only when props are picked.
Don't: Wrap every dependency in styled() by default.
Notes: Dynamic class lists are fine: join conditional utilities into one string or use cn.
